title: Are You REALLY A2 in French? 🇫🇷 Take the Test!
description:
🇫🇷 Are you really A2 in French? Let's find out! 🤔 In this video, I'll help you discover if you've reached the A2 level in French with 5 essential skills every A2 French learner should master!

Can you talk about your past, describe your future plans, express your needs and handle everyday situations in French? Together, we'll explore the grammar, vocabulary and expressions you need to know at A2 level, with practical examples and a few common mistakes to avoid!

Whether you're preparing for the DELF A2 exam, moving from A1 to A2, or simply wondering what your current French level is, this video will help you evaluate your progress and feel more confident speaking French! ❤️

💬 YOUR TURN! Try the exercises at the end of the video and share your answers in the comments! And don't forget to look for the secret word! 🤫

❤️ BUILD YOUR OWN FRENCH LIBRARY WITH ME ON PATREON!

Imagine receiving beautiful French literature books directly at your doorstep, personally selected by your French teacher! 📚 Every month, I choose French books adapted to your level and send them to your home, along with a little handwritten note explaining why I chose them for you.

More than 20 members have already joined, and some have built an impressive collection of French books!

💌 Join my Patreon and start your French reading journey with me: 👉 https://www.patreon.com/francais_avec_nelly/membership?l=fr-FR&vanity=francais_avec_nelly

👋 BONJOUR, I'M NELLY!

I'm Nelly, your French teacher (and your French friend 😄).
Every week, I help you improve your French naturally through French culture, literature, real conversations and everyday life in France.
